items.title_orig: What lyric is as sad as that bar from Pearl Jam's "Black"?
items.article_text:
"I know someday you'll have a beautiful life, I know you'll be a star in somebody else's sky, but Why? Why? Why can't it be? Oh, can't it be mine?" The way he sings this breaks me every time, and I wondered what you all could add that was comparable
    submitted by    /u/Sagoingne    to    r/Music
